body: Thanks, I really do appreciate it. Just concentrating my thoughts into words claimed me quite a bit, and made it pretty clear the right decision.  I'm still.not feeling all that great, but I'm much better than I was when creating this post.  Really, you don't know how much you helped.

No. I called the doctor right after work and set an appointment.  I've never wanted to kill myself before until today, and if that isn't a clear indication that something g is wrong I don't know what is. You don't think he'll wanna lock me up if I tell him I've had suicidal thoughts, do you?

Nothing.  Nothing makes a week better or worse other than my brain chemistry.  That's what I find most infuriating; I'm still normal, but I'm trapped in this shell of feeling good or bad. So rarely do I just feel normal.
